title: Path Sum
statement: Return true when the tree has a root-to-leaf path whose values sum to `target_sum`.
hints: Subtract the current value from the target as you descend.
A leaf matches when the remaining target equals the leaf value.
A null node is not a successful path. An empty tree is false.

approaches.name: BFS with remaining sum
approaches.explanation: Carry the remainder in the queue.

editorial: has_path_sum(null, _) is false. A leaf returns whether its value equals the remaining target. An internal node returns true when either child can finish the remainder after subtracting the node value.

examples.input: root = [5, 4, 8, 11, None, 13, 4, 7, 2, None, None, None, 1], target_sum = 22
